question: Do actual public dose-support and observed-range summaries improve first-screen substitutions beyond the frozen prior and design-only correction?
baseline: Supplied prior_control_score, original tie order, screen fraction 0.7, two rounds, ceil(0.2*menu) unit credits
menu: All 4519 candidates, 14 complete cell groups, both directions together; no coverage filtering
endpoint: Purchased source hit1 followed by purchased source hit2; published fitted calls, not independent culture confirmation
conditions: Library concentration is curve top in uM; anchor_set is a set of fixed-dose vectors in uM, not one well. local_days=4 is seeding-to-read, treatment duration is 72h by Jaaks methods.
mono_source: Existing GDSC2 release8.5 plus preserved mono_labels.csv.gz and audited drug_identity_map.csv
mono_exclusion: Exclude every cell marked cell_excluded_from_mono (126 entities, including Jaaks cells and recorded related exclusion). All 14 target cells must be excluded. No target-specific mono values, Z_SCORE or RMSE features.
mono_support: Require exact drug registry match and exact library top-dose range. At least 5 distinct non-Jaaks cells per group. Tissue-specific summaries where >=5, otherwise global reference with transport flag. Anchor dose support uses highest fixed dose, exact top range preferred, otherwise closest top range on log scale explicitly flagged.
features: Design logs and anchor span; mono median lnIC50, fraction in measured range, median AUC, dose relative median potency, inside-tested-range flag, dose-range transport, tissue transport, count and missingness. Pair product of bounded-dose-supported mono margins is a learned covariate, never a joint mechanism probability. No fabricated slope or Emax.
model: Centered/scaled ridge residual of joint binary historical call minus frozen prior score; mean loss gives equal total weight to each cell-role. Same alpha and ridge grids per correction arm; zero correction allowed. Missing or composite candidates use exact static fallback in all correction arms.
split: Outer leave-one-cell-out; inner leave-one-cell-out of 13 development cells for parameter selection. Both roles remain together. Only 13 historical cells' joint labels are given to training in each outer fold. Scale/imputation fit on training rows only.
selection: Inner legal-replay confirmed yield, ties prefer alpha0 then lower alpha then stronger shrinkage. Final confirmation order remains frozen static for every arm to isolate screen substitutions.
shuffle: One fixed seed 20261007. Permute functional mono feature blocks within exact tissue, library top dose, anchor_set and support status; preserve design and missingness. Report fraction actually moved. This is a diagnostic, not a randomization p-value.
outputs: swapped-in/out condition identities and joint-label contributions
limitations: All14 cells already exposed; no confirmatory claim
GDSC parameters share original NLME fit; removing target rows does not refit that model or certify parameter independence
Public references are available at this replay experiment time, not certified available before historical2016 screens
Public menu is complete-repeat retrospective subset
Credits and rounds are simulated, not money and physical deadline
continuation: Do not fetch ChEMBL or LINCS or promote into src solely because a tuned exploratory arm wins. Require useful boundary replacement beyond design/missingness and mapping-destroying control, then freeze an independent task and cost threshold. If richer dose evidence is insufficient, report its specific acquisition gaps.
preservation: Original ZIP, HTML, imported20 files and historical freezes remain unchanged. New outputs must refuse an existing destination.
